sources: Prop masses are start values chosen for the app (user can edit kg in the player), approximate start value, not verified against the original; kg is the total for the load point (hands = split over both hands).
note: toward/track are directions of the force the load applies to the body (y up, z body-forward); the engine normalises them. handle toward is the default (row); towardByVariant overrides it by exercises.json record id (pulley direction differs per exercise). legpress track: force of the sled on the feet, down and back along the leg-press rails (45 degrees, equipment.json leg-press railLeft/railRight rx -45), changed in R5 T9a from the 35-degree start value so the load agrees with the drawn machine; magnitude is kg x g along the rail (the true push of a 45-degree sled is kg x g x sin 45; simplification). The leg-press record carries legpress since R5 T9b. band = elastic, modelled as a cable with force kg x g at the stretched keyframe (simplification); the band prop pulls each hand toward the other (band pull-apart). R5 T9b props: kettlebell = kettlebell at both hands; crossover = two high pulleys, one per hand, pulling out, up and back (cable fly; one cable column is drawn); hipBar = barbell across the hips at hipsFront (hip thrust); legext and legcurl = machine lever pad at the shins, track fixed at the 45-degree midpoint of the lever arc (simplification: on the machine the direction turns with the knee angle). Task builder props (taskbuilder.json): <object> = the load at both hands (split), <object>R = at the right hand; furniture-edge is the push/pull force, a horizontal cable along body z, toward by task key tasks/push (pushes back on the hands) and tasks/pull (pulls them forward); its kg is the force to move it.
